sloka: निवेश्य ते पुरवरे आत्मजौ सन्निवेश्य च ।आगमिष्यति मे भूयः सकाशमतिधार्मिकः ।। ७.१००.१८ ॥
transliteration: niveśya te puravare ātmajau sanniveśya ca ।āgamiṣyati me bhūyaḥ sakāśamatidhārmikaḥ ।। 7.100.18 ॥

translations.english: Having established those excellent cities and settled his sons there, the very righteous Bharata will return to my presence again.
translations.hindi: ॥ हे पुरुषसिंह ! ये तुम्हारे वचन, वीरतायुक्त एवं घमसम्मत ड तथा प्रथिवी के बीरों की रक्षा करने वाले हूँ
